5.3.3 br : Linebreak

This tag will cause the text to be continued on the next line, without starting a new paragraph.

Example:

Normal text on first line <br/>Continued on next line.

will be formatted as:
Normal text on first line
Continued on next line.

See also: i (188), u (232).
